scope: Proposition 2.1 of the manuscript “The Margulis–Platonov conjecture over global function fields” (preprints/The-Margulis-Platonov-conjecture-over-global-function-fields-October-5-2026/margulis-platonov-global-function-fields.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 018 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7e90f88648f7bafc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the groups in (2.1), the following statements hold in every positive charac- teristic. (i) The determinant maps U(k) → L1 and their local analogues are surjective. (ii) The groups S and U satisfy weak approximation. (iii) Every place in A splits in L/k. At such a place there is a central division algebra Dv of degree n over kv for which U(kv) ≃ D× v , S(kv) ≃ SL1(Dv). Under this identification the determinant is NrdDv/kv .
